{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "theuni",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "suggested waiting for std::span replacement (#31519) before specializing on extents"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",

      "note": "questioned sha256 changes and struggled to reproduce speedups, while noting potential usefulness for the kernel"
    },

      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "questioned real-world IBD speedup and motivation since BufferedReader and BufferedWriter already buffer AutoFile writes"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:1956480589",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "premature specialization without static extent support from the std::span replacement",
      "quote": "I think it makes sense to wait for the std::span replacement (#31519) to do this, that way we can specialize for any static extent instead",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:1956688357",
        "c:2709143828",
        "rc:1986458092",
        "rc:2005441297"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2005441297",
      "settled_by_quote": "Now that #31519 was merged, I've rebased an moved it out of draft."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2049014604",
      "kind": "scope",
      "harm": "unclear benefit of specializing single-byte writes in crypto/sha256 adds complexity",
      "quote": "I'm not sure about all these crypto changes. Will this be noticable at all? Why only do it for the sha256 hasher?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],

      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2813398761",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "harm": "AutoFile single-byte write optimizations are not hit during production IBD because reads and writes are already buffered",
      "quote": "The Buffered* then passes them to AutoFile, which is modified here, but never receives 1-byte writes anymore",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2813392140",
        "c:4846395622"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "rc:1956480589",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "These are nice optims",
      "substantive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "r:2775842648",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "This looks ok, albeit that I'm seeing more modest performance improvements on my end.",
      "substantive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2845097684",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "I think block serialization being fast could be useful for future kernel users. Reading and de-serializing blocks is one of the common operations I'd expect outside of just pure block validation.",
      "substantive": true
    }

  "notes": "The PR remains in draft. theuni's request to wait for #31519 was resolved when it merged and the branch was rebased, but nonblocking questions from maflcko regarding whether the modified paths actually affect IBD and from sedited regarding the sha256 optimizations remain open."
